exposure: methods of induction (Dinoprost gel, Misoprostol, Oxytocin with or without artificial rupture of membranes)
cohort: 100 Primiparous women at >41 weeks of gestation with live singleton fetus in cephalic presentation in whom labor was induced.
finding: Induction of labor in primigravida at term is associated with a significantly increased risk of cesarean delivery.
